name: Kalmeshwar–Saoner National Highway
significance: NH 547E is a branch of NH 547. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Kalmeshwar to Saoner, and it meets NH 547 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 547 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Saoner to Narsinghpur
